name: Run Code
description: Run Python or bash in an isolated Linux sandbox and return its output: for arithmetic beyond the trivial, data, files, charts, or anything you'd otherwise estimate. The working folder /work is this chat's scratch (kept for a week after the chat's last run); /project is the workspace's folder, shared by all its chats and kept, so move what should last there (mv /work/x /project/). pip installs go to /project and last too. /pages holds this workspace's published pages, read-only. Send a whole script per call. numpy, pandas, matplotlib and requests are installed; PyPI is reachable but nothing else on the network. Use bash to list, read, move and delete files.
author: anything

examples.prompt: What's 17% compound interest on 2,400 over 9 years, year by year?
What files do we have for this project?

language.description: "python" (Python 3.13) or "bash" (Debian with coreutils, git and curl).

code.description: A complete script. It runs in /work.

timeout.description: Seconds before the run is killed: 60 if not given, at most 300.
